diseases.name: Leptospirosis
diseases.rationale: This condition is characterized by the sudden onset of fever, rigors, headache, and muscle pain, particularly in the calf and lumbar areas. These symptoms align with the questionnaire's inquiry about body ache and associated fever.

diseases.name: Infective Endocarditis
diseases.rationale: This condition can present with influenza-like or polymyalgia-like syndromes, which would include body aches. Associated symptoms like low-grade fever and anorexia (which can cause fatigue/weakness) are also relevant to the questionnaire.

diseases.name: Myocardial Infarction
diseases.rationale: While chest pain is the classic symptom, patients may experience fatigue, malaise, and discomfort in the days or weeks preceding the event. The pain can also radiate to the neck and shoulder, which could be described as an ache.

diseases.name: Lyme Disease
diseases.rationale: Lyme disease is a tick-borne illness known to cause various symptoms, including body aches and fatigue. The questionnaire asks about associated skin changes, and Lyme disease is famously associated with an erythema migrans rash.

diseases.name: Vertebral Artery Dissection
diseases.rationale: This condition can present with ipsilateral facial pain and numbness. While often described as pain, this could be interpreted or reported as a severe ache, particularly in the head and neck region, which is an option in the questionnaire.

diseases.name: Acrodermatitis Chronica Atrophicans
diseases.rationale: This condition, a late manifestation of Lyme disease, is associated with neuropathy symptoms, including pain and paresthesia, which could be described as body aches, particularly in the extremities. The questionnaire also asks about skin changes, which are a hallmark of this disease.
